ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with high-intensity white pixels restricted to localized distal barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous low-intensity black field. Distal tips (left and right) exhibit high-contrast white and beige geometric blobs localized at the peripheral boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 15 pixels in depth relative to the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the submerged center, curving upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white and textured beige pixel groups concentrated at the extreme distal ends of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle growth causing significant protrusion and texture irregularity at the left and right distal tips.
